headline: Eli Lilly Acquires 4E Therapeutics to Advance Chronic Pain Pipeline
summary: Eli Lilly and Company has acquired 4E Therapeutics, a neuroscience company developing non-opioid MNK inhibitors for chronic pain.

headline: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Joins Presidential Delegation to Beijing
summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has joined a U.S. presidential delegation traveling to Beijing, following a reversal of an earlier decision to exclude the company from the trip.

summary: Warren Buffett has disclosed his intention to fully dispose of his remaining Berkshire Hathaway shareholdings by December 31, 2034.
notes: 2034 is just too far away to have an immediate impact

headline: Johnson & Johnson Insider Reports Share Sale
summary: A Johnson & Johnson insider disclosed the sale of company shares valued at approximately $5.79 million in a recent SEC filing.

summary: Caterpillar and its partners are presenting a prototype SWS 6 Spiral Shaft Separator powered by a new battery electric power unit at the IFAT 2026 exhibition in Munich.
notes: Hard to tell if this experimental item will increase stock price

headline: Costco Selects Moloco for New 'Reserved Display' Ad Format
summary: Costco has partnered with Moloco to implement a new onsite advertising format called 'Reserved Display' on Costco.com as part of its retail media network.

headline: Wells Fargo Adjusts Price Target on Alphabet to $438
summary: Wells Fargo has updated its research coverage on Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL), increasing the price target for the company's shares to $438 from the previous $416 and maintaining its overweight rating.

headline: Reolink Launches Video Doorbell 2nd Gen Featuring Qualcomm QCC730 Wi-Fi Solution
summary: Reolink has released its Video Doorbell 2nd Gen, which utilizes Qualcomm Technologies' QCC730 micro-power Wi-Fi solution to enhance battery efficiency.

headline: Amgen Submits New Data to Challenge FDA's Proposal to Withdraw Tavneos
summary: Amgen has submitted additional clinical data to the FDA in a formal effort to contest the agency's proposal to withdraw the marketing authorization for its rare disease therapy, Tavneos.

headline: Suntory PepsiCo Thailand Advances 'Consumer First' Strategy
summary: Suntory PepsiCo Beverage (Thailand) Co., Ltd. has announced the advancement of its 'Consumer First' business strategy for the second half of 2026, focusing on deep consumer insights, organizational capability, and sustainability.

headline: Indian Parliamentary Committee to Summon Meta and Other Tech Giants Over Net Neutrality
summary: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Communications and Information Technology has announced plans to summon Meta Platforms, along with other major digital platforms, to discuss net neutrality and equal internet access.

summary: Broadcom and OpenAI have introduced 'Jalapeño,' a custom AI accelerator chip designed specifically for large language model (LLM) inference.

headline: Mastercard Named Coupa Pay Virtual Card Partner of the Year
summary: Mastercard was recognized as the 'Coupa Pay Virtual Card Partner of the Year' at the 2026 Coupa Inspire Partner Summit for its contributions to spend management innovation.

summary: IREN Ltd has secured $3.6 billion in financing to acquire Nvidia GPUs for a data center project that supports Microsoft's AI infrastructure needs.

summary: Dayos Pte. Ltd. has announced the general availability of Athena, an agentic platform designed to provide automated support for Oracle and Workday environments.

summary: Eli Lilly expressed disappointment regarding reports that some U.S. employers intend to discontinue coverage for obesity management medications in 2027.

summary: NVIDIA has commenced initial shipments of its new Vera CPU systems to key AI research organizations, including Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

summary: Berkshire Hathaway has completed the liquidation of its approximately 5 million shares in UnitedHealth Group.

summary: Johnson & Johnson has placed an initial order for a custom laser-drilling system from Laser Photonics Corporation, marking the latter's entry into medical device manufacturing.

headline: Analyst Jerry Revich Maintains Buy Rating on Caterpillar
summary: Analyst Jerry Revich has reaffirmed a 'Buy' rating on Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) and maintained a price target of $1,155.

summary: Coco5 has announced a new retail partnership to bring its hydration products to Costco warehouse locations.

summary: Wells Fargo upgraded Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. (CBRL) to overweight from equalweight and adjusted its price target to $50 from $35 on June 10, 2026.

summary: Qualcomm is planning to adapt its new data center chip technology for use in smartphones to enhance on-device AI performance.

summary: Amgen was honored with the 2026 Goldies Award at the CECP Summit for its Amgen Biotech Experience (ABE) program, which provides science education resources to students and teachers.

summary: Doritos has unveiled a new global campaign titled 'The Crunch Prix' as part of its official partnership with Formula 1, aiming to connect the brand's snacking experience with the excitement of racing.

summary: Investment advisor JLens is calling on Meta shareholders to vote for a proposal at the upcoming May 27 annual meeting that would require the company to report on its effectiveness in combating antisemitism and online hate.

summary: Broadcom has entered into a new long-term agreement to continue developing and supplying custom silicon products for Apple through 2031.

summary: Mastercard has entered a strategic partnership with African stablecoin infrastructure provider Yellow Card to improve cross-border payment efficiency across the EEMEA region.

summary: Microsoft and inLab FIB have signed a three-year agreement to reinforce their existing research and technology collaboration.

headline: HSBC Adjusts Price Target on Oracle to $316
summary: HSBC has revised its price target for Oracle Corporation, adjusting it to $316 from the previous $345.

summary: Eli Lilly and Company has secured global rights to AlzeCure Pharma's Alzheimer's disease drug candidate, Alzstatin (ACD680), through a new collaboration and out-licensing agreement.

headline: SharonAI Discloses $1.25 Billion Contract for 8,200 NVIDIA B300 GPUs

summary: Following strong second-quarter 2026 financial results, Johnson & Johnson confirmed it is on track to reach its annual revenue goal of more than $100 billion for the first time in its history.
